warn_percent.label: Warning threshold (%)
warn_percent.description: Below this percentage, while discharging, the full-screen alert appears.

critical_percent.label: Critical threshold (%)
critical_percent.description: Below this percentage the alarm sounds continuously and can only be snoozed for 1 minute.

snooze_minutes.label: Snooze (minutes)
snooze_minutes.description: How long until the alert returns after pressing Snooze at the low level.

sound.label: Alarm sound
sound.description: Play a beep while the alert is on screen.
